payload.reasoning_hinge_summary: The candidate must equate the scaling of weight (m ∝ r³) with the scaling of drag (F_d ∝ r²v²) to derive the relationship v ∝ √r, then apply the mass ratio to find the velocity ratio.
payload.expected_mid_student_error: Students will likely fail to account for the r² dependence in the drag force, incorrectly assuming drag is only proportional to v², or they will fail to correctly relate mass to radius (r ∝ m^(1/3)).
notes: The problem is a classic 'Extreme' difficulty ESAT question because it requires synthesis of two proportionalities rather than simple formula application.
The distractors are well-aligned with common conceptual pitfalls in scaling problems.
